verses.translation: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—
secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—
let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿiw-waāmanahum min khawfin
verses.translation: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear
